title: #60 Torbjörn Arenbo: Capital Allocation and Value Creation
summary:
Arend Bo has 25 years experience working as a corporate finance advisor, portfolio manager, and risk manager. We will talk about his book, Capital Allocation and Value Creation, a market-based framework for executives. Capital allocation and value creation was published in December, 2003, and we are delighted to discuss it with
the author today.

reader_summary.headline: Hello, everyone and welcome to Investing by the Books, a podcast by Red Eye.
reader_summary.overview: Hello, everyone and welcome to Investing by the Books, a podcast by Red Eye. I'm your host, Nikla Savos, and with me in the studio today is my friend, Henrik Andersson. Today we're excited to speak to Torbjian Arenbo, chief analyst and head of corporate advisory, Sweden at Danske Bank.

thesis: The speakers discuss Torbjörn Arenbo's book 'Capital Allocation and Value Creation,' which aims to link corporate executives' approaches to capital structure and funding with the asset management side of investing. The book is written for corporate leaders like CFOs and CEOs to provide a practical framework for value creation, distinguishing itself from other texts that focus primarily on investors.
